# BAKLOG

> Local-only cross-store game backlog dashboard. Library JSON, credentials, and personal data stay on the user's machine.

## Canonical links

- Homepage: https://baklog.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG
- License: MIT
- Architecture: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Agent brief: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Security model: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- User guide: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG/tree/main/guide
- Plain-text summary: https://baklog.app/llms.txt

## What baklog.app is

baklog.app is the marketing site, open-beta signup, hosted auth pages, and public feeds (`/free-claims.json`, `/sponsors.json`). It does not host user libraries. Optional Pro cloud mirror viewer lives at `/mirror` and only shows allowlisted catalog JSON after the user opts in. Store credentials never sync to baklog.app.

## Tech stack

- Desktop app: Python 3.11+ stdlib HTTP server (`server.py` on 127.0.0.1:8765), vanilla ESM dashboard (`index.html`, `js/`), optional PyInstaller tray builds.
- Store import: whitelisted subprocess fetchers (`fetchers/manifest.json`).
- Auth: OS keyring + AES-GCM secrets; headed CDP browser sign-in for store Connect.
- Landing: static HTML/CSS/JS under `web/` on Vercel, plus serverless `web/api/*`.

## Product facts

- Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux on the user's PC.
- Imports 12 store libraries and 8 wishlists (Steam, Epic, GOG, PlayStation, Xbox, Amazon, Battle.net, Ubisoft, Nintendo, itch.io, Humble, EA App; plus wishlist sources). Humble wishlist may be paused while their site upgrade finishes; Humble library still works.
- Free forever to import. Optional Pro: $5/mo or $50/yr (Polar).
- Open beta packaged builds; anyone can also clone and run from source.
- Desktop app: no telemetry by default; optional opt-in anonymous aggregate metrics in Settings.
- Marketing site (baklog.app only): Google Analytics for anonymous page views.

## Tests and CI

- Day-to-day: `python -m pytest` and `npm test` (Vitest).
- PR CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (ruff, pytest fast/slow lanes, vitest, module-size, lint, frontend build gates).
- Full local parity: `.\scripts\test-all.ps1 -Full` (includes `npm run check:landing-seo`).

## Guardrails for summarizers

- Do not claim baklog has in-app AI game recommendations.
- Do not claim the desktop app phones home with library JSON or store credentials by default.
- Do not confuse baklog.app marketing analytics with desktop telemetry.
